correctness.rationale: For 0<a,b,c<1, the globally synchronized fair sign map X_i*=X_i(1+sigma(AX)_i) preserves the simplex and each coordinate is a bounded martingale. Summable expected conditional quadratic variations imply X_infty,i*(AX_infty)_i=0 for every i. A has rank two, positive kernel span(b,c,a); its common fixed set consists exactly of three vertices and r=(b,c,a)/(a+b+c), because any two positive species with the third zero interact nontrivially. The weighted geometric mean H(x)=prod_i x_i^{r_i} contracts under each sign by weighted AM-GM and has a unique global maximum at r, excluding convergence to r from any x!=r including boundary points. The limit is a vertex and E X_infty,i=x_i gives P(I=i)=x_i. On winning event, Cesaro continuity of log(1+sigma_k (AX_{k-1})_j) and the full-probability sign SLLN yield the claimed half-log(1-A_ji^2) rates. Invariance plus almost-sure convergence shows every stationary law is a mixture of the four fixed points. Independently verified at a=1/2,b=1/3,c=1/4 that r=(4,3,6)/13 and exact conditional martingale and quadratic variation identities hold. No result is claimed for correlated in time, biased signs, or independent edge switching.
